english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for one kick as a physical blow or strike.
Use this noun phrase for one kick or blow delivered with the foot.

examples.english: They gave me a kick.鏡頭要影晒成個舞台。
They were so angry that they gave me a boot in the shins.
